configuration.hooks: hooks object in .gemini/settings.json (project), ~/.gemini/settings.json (user), system settings and extensions; per event: [{matcher, sequential, hooks:[{type: command, command, name, timeout, description}]}]
configuration.trust: measured: without trust, gemini -p exits 55 ('Gemini CLI is not running in a trusted directory ... --skip-trust, GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true, or trust this directory in interactive mode'); an untrusted folder also ignores .gemini/settings.json and .env. With per-run trust, stderr warns 'The following project-level hooks have been detected in this workspace' and the hooks run.
configuration.trusted_hooks_write: measured: the first run wrote ~/.gemini/trusted_hooks.json (397 -> 2968 bytes): 22 hook identities (name + command) under the project path. ~/.gemini/trustedFolders.json unchanged (no persistent folder trust).
configuration.auth_note: measured: Vertex AI needs GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION; ~/.gemini/.env holds them but is not read in an untrusted folder (exit 41 before the trust check). Exported per run; values not printed.
configuration.headless: gemini -p '<prompt>' --output-format json -> {session_id, response, stats}; --allowed-tools must be one flag per tool with = (a bare second value is read as a positional prompt)
configuration.mcp: documented: mcpServers in .gemini/settings.json (project, trusted folders only) or user settings; tools named mcp_<server>_<tool>. Not exercised.

model.native: BeforeModel (4), AfterModel (25, per streamed chunk), BeforeToolSelection (4)

compress.notes: 4 times with trigger auto in a short run

notification.fires: not in this run (no permission prompt in headless mode)

deny.shape: top-level {decision: deny, reason}; the tool result reads 'Tool execution blocked: <reason>' and the model reports it

context.shape: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; transcript user content wrapped in <hook_context>...</hook_context>

stop_context.notes: AfterAgent decision deny forces a retry with reason as the new prompt; stop_hook_active marks it. Not exercised (the probe does not deny AfterAgent).

rewrite.notes: BeforeTool hookSpecificOutput.tool_input merges into the arguments

trust: folder trust required for project settings (and so project hooks) in headless mode; new project hook identities warned about and recorded in ~/.gemini/trusted_hooks.json

context.notes: pause, broadcast and shared_checkout notices reached the model; held context arrived at the next delivering event
